name: Auto Computation - Attendance Full Data & Monthly View

parameters.query:
WITH 
emp AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    avatar_url,
    designation,
    joining_date,
    employment_type,
    work_location,
    role,
    is_active
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
     OR LOWER(email) = LOWER('{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}')
  LIMIT 1
),
target_month_info AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF('{{ $json.targetMonth }}', ''), TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')) AS month_key
),
today_att AS (
  SELECT 
    a.id,
    a.employee_id,
    a.date::TEXT,
    a.check_in,
    a.check_out,
    a.status,
    a.status_label,
    a.expected_checkout_time AS expected_check_out_time,
    a.work_duration_minutes,
    a.total_duration_minutes,
    a.lunch_duration_minutes,
    a.late_allowance_used,
    a.is_half_day_case,
    a.notes,
    COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', p.id,
      'type', p.type,
      'timestamp', p.timestamp,
      'timeString', p.time_string,
      'location', p.location,
      'note', p.note
    ) ORDER BY p.timestamp ASC) FILTER (WHERE p.id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) AS punches
  FROM attendances a
  LEFT JOIN attendance_punches p ON p.attendance_id = a.id
  WHERE a.employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND a.date = CURRENT_DATE
  GROUP BY a.id, a.employee_id, a.date, a.check_in, a.check_out, a.status, a.status_label,
           a.expected_checkout_time, a.work_duration_minutes, a.total_duration_minutes,
           a.lunch_duration_minutes, a.late_allowance_used, a.is_half_day_case, a.notes
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_att AS (
  SELECT 
    month_key,
    total_recorded_days,
    present_days,
    on_time_days,
    within_buffer_days,
    late_days,
    late_allowances_used,
    late_allowances_remaining,
    half_days,
    absent_days,
    leave_days,
    holidays,
    total_work_hours,
    average_hours_per_day
  FROM v_monthly_attendance_summary
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND month_key = (SELECT month_key FROM target_month_info)
  LIMIT 1
),
month_records AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', a.id,
    'employeeId', a.employee_id,
    'date', a.date::TEXT,
    'checkIn', a.check_in,
    'checkOut', a.check_out,
    'status', a.status,
    'statusLabel', a.status_label,
    'expectedCheckOutTime', a.expected_checkout_time,
    'workDurationMinutes', a.work_duration_minutes,
    'totalDurationMinutes', a.total_duration_minutes,
    'lunchDurationMinutes', a.lunch_duration_minutes,
    'lateAllowanceUsed', a.late_allowance_used,
    'isHalfDayCase', a.is_half_day_case,
    'notes', a.notes,
    'punches', COALESCE((
      SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
        'id', p.id,
        'type', p.type,
        'timestamp', p.timestamp,
        'timeString', p.time_string,
        'location', p.location,
        'note', p.note
      ) ORDER BY p.timestamp ASC)
      FROM attendance_punches p
      WHERE p.attendance_id = a.id
    ), '[]'::json)
  ) ORDER BY a.date DESC), '[]'::json) AS records_list
  FROM attendances a
  WHERE a.employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND TO_CHAR(a.date, 'YYYY-MM') = (SELECT month_key FROM target_month_info)
),
month_holidays AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
    'id', id,
    'name', name,
    'date', date::TEXT,
    'day', day,
    'type', type,
    'description', description,
    'isOfficeClosed', is_office_closed
  ) ORDER BY date ASC), '[]'::json) AS holiday_list
  FROM holidays
  WHERE TO_CHAR(date, 'YYYY-MM') = (SELECT month_key FROM target_month_info)
)
SELECT 
  (CASE WHEN emp.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS employee_found,
  (SELECT month_key FROM target_month_info) AS selected_month,
  row_to_json(emp.*) AS employee,
  row_to_json(today_att.*) AS today_attendance,
  row_to_json(monthly_att.*) AS monthly_summary,
  (SELECT records_list FROM month_records) AS month_records,
  (SELECT holiday_list FROM month_holidays) AS holidays
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN emp ON true
LEFT JOIN today_att ON true
LEFT JOIN monthly_att ON true
LIMIT 1;
